title.en: AN ACT FIXING THE TERM OF OFFICE OF BARANGAY OFFICIALS AND MEMBERS OF THE SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN TO FIVE (5) YEARS, AMENDING TERM OF OFFICE OF BARANGAY OFFICIALS AND MEMBERS OF THE SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

text.en:
Section 1 of Republic Act No. 12232 or "An
Act Setting the Term of Office of Barangay Officials and
Members of the Sangguniang Kabataan, and for Other
Purposes" is hereby amended to read as follows:

"SECTION 1. Term of Office.
office of all elected barangay and Sangguniang
Kabataan officials shall be five (5) vears. No elective
barangay official shall serve for more than two (2)
consecutive terms in the same position. No elective
Sangguniang Kabataan official shall serve for more
than one (1) term in the same position. Voluntary
renunciation of office for any length of time shall not
be considered as an interruption in the continuitv
of service for the full term for which the elective
official was elected."

Section 2 of Republic Act No. 12282 is hereby
amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 2. Date of Election. - The next regular
barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections shall
be held on the second Monday of November 2028 and
every five (5) years thereafter."
A new Section 4-A is hereby inserted after

of Republic Act No. 12232, to read as follows:
provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding,
a vacancy in the membership of the Sangguniang
Kabataan shall be filled through the appointment by
the city or municipal mayor with jurisdiction over
the barangay of the concerned Sangguniang
Kabataan of any person who meets, as of the date
of appointment, the qualifications provided under

of Republic Act No. 10742 or the
'Sangguniang Kabataan Reform
amended by Republic Act No. 11768: Provided, That
vacancies in the office of the Sangguniang Kabataan
chairperson shall not be subiect to this provision
and shall be filled by succession as provided in
Section 19(a) of Republic Act No. 10742, as amended."
SEC. 4. A new Section 4-B is hereby inserted after the
new Section 4.A to read as follows:
"SEC. 4-B. Training and Capacity Building, -
Consistent with the five (5)-year term of office
established under this Act, the Department of
the Interior and Local Government (DILG), in
coordination with the Technical Education and Skills
Development Authority (TESDA), Commission on
Elections (COMELEC), state universities and colleges
(SUCs), and other appropriate government agencies,
shall institutionalize continuing training and
capacity-building programs for barangay officials and
members of the Sangguniang Kabataan to strengthen
their capacity to perform their duties and
responsibilities and to ensure continuity in the
implementation of barangay and Sangguniang
Kabataan programs and projects. Such programs
shall, as far as practicable, be coordinated and
harmonized to avoid unnecessary duplication and
recurring training costs."
Sec. 5. Section 5 of Republic Act No. 12232 is hereby
amended to read as follows:
"SeC. 5. Transitory Provision. - Considering
the extension of their terms by two (2) years,
incumbent elective barangay officials shall be
regarded as having completed one (1) term in their
respective positions. Incumbent officials serving their
last term in the same position in accordance with
Section 1 hereof shall be ineligible to run for the
same position in the November 2028 Borangay and
Sangguniang Kabataan Elections."
SEc. 6. Limitation During Transition Period, - Nothing
in this Act shall be construed to exempt any incumbent otficial
from pending and future investigations concerning
administrative, civil, or criminal cases or liabilities against
them, and the consequences thereof during such incumbency:
Provided, That incumbent officials with such pending cases
may be prevented from sitting during the transition period in
accordance with law as may be ordered by the courts or
competent authority.
Sec. 7. Appropriations. - The amount necessary to
implement the provisions of this Act shall be included in the
General Appropriations Act.

Any unexpended balance of the appropriations authorized
for the conduct of the barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan
elections shall be deemed continuing appropriation of the
COMELEC and shall remain available as funding source to
cover the preparatory activities for the 2028 National and Local
Elections and such other lawful expenditures and purposes as
may be determined by the Commission.
Sec. 8. Separability Clause. - If any provision or part
of this Act is declared unconstitutional, the remainder hereof
not otherwise affected shall remain in full force and effect.
SEc. 9. Repealing Clause. - All laws, acts, decrees,
executive orders, issuances, rules and regulations, or parts
thereof which are contrary to and inconsistent with the
provisions of this Act are hereby repealed, amended, or modified
accordingly.
Sec. 10. Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect
immediately after its publication in the Official Gazette or in
a newspaper of general circulation.
